nodes.label: A — Felt Moonlight / gameplay bed
nodes.prompt: Original instrumental music for Starfall, a tiny moonlit puzzle about releasing starlight from precious chunky crystals. Quiet wonder, tactile warmth, gentle concentration, intimate scale. Provisional D major pentatonic palette D E F-sharp A B, softly stable D and A harmony. No vocals, words, choir, drums, ticking, rhythmic pressure, bass drops, risers, epic orchestra, casino sparkle, brittle treble, recognizable existing melody, or final-move urgency. Leave generous silence between musical gestures and a clear middle register for soft glass action sounds. Rounded transients, subtle stereo width, centered fundamentals, no hard panning. 30-second restrained gameplay mood sketch. Warm felt piano, softly damped glass mallet and a barely audible breath of warm bowed pad. Unhurried approximate 64 BPM with no audible click or driving pulse; long held chords and very occasional two-note piano answers. Evoke the comfortable weight of a crystal in the hand. Almost static harmony, no build, no obvious intro or closing cadence; the opening and ending should have compatible texture for a later carefully edited loop. This is a quiet background bed, not a foreground performance.
